name: The Buried Moon
source:
Rattia Brown is sent to the village of Star Veil to get some field experience as a member of the Edge Guard, along with her commanding officer. However, what was meant to be easy becomes harder when ghostly creatures begin to appear in the woods surrounding the town. Worse still, the moon seems to have grown dim.

The Buried Moon was Created for [url=http://www.asylumjam.com/]Asylum Jam[/url] by Metal Orphans & Co.

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=23637]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
作为边境卫队的一员，拉蒂娅·布朗与她的指挥官一同被派往星纱村进行实地历练。然而，原本应该很轻松的任务，却在镇外森林中出现幽灵般的生物后变得困难起来。更糟的是，月亮似乎也变得黯淡了。

《The Buried Moon》由Metal Orphans及其团队为[url=http://www.asylumjam.com/]Asylum Jam[/url]创作。

[译自[url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=23637]Lemma Soft论坛[/url]]
